pip-compile.description: Manage the hash-pinned docs lock: read docs/requirements.txt's pip-compile header, bump deps in docs/requirements.in, and regenerate the lock with --generate-hashes.

customManagers.description: Track the pinned zizmor (GitHub Actions security auditor) version installed in security.yml's `uv tool install zizmor==<ver>`. It is installed via uv at run time, so neither the github-actions nor any package manager sees it. Held for review (vendored) by the base policy.

Track the pinned knope release consumed via knope-dev/action's `with: version:` input (knope-release.yml + knope-prepare.yml). The github-actions manager pins the action's `uses:` SHA but not the version: input, so knope drifted silently. Reads the `# renovate:` annotation on the line directly above `version:`. knope's release tags are monorepo-prefixed (knope/vX.Y.Z), so the annotation carries an extractVersion the regex reads per-line. Held for review (vendored) by the base policy — a release tool, reviewed not auto-merged.

Track the openapi-typescript version pinned in the build:client npm script. It is invoked with npx at build time, so it is not a package.json dependency and neither the npm nor github-actions manager sees it.

Track the agent-browser CLI pinned in the e2e job's `npm i -g agent-browser@X.Y.Z`. It is installed globally in the workflow, deliberately kept out of package.json to avoid pulling Chromium into every npm ci, so neither the npm nor github-actions manager sees it. Held (vendored) by the base policy — an intentional heads-up before the e2e driver moves, since the e2e leg is a non-required check a human verifies green.

packageRules.description: docs/requirements.txt is a hash-pinned pip-compile lock (generated from docs/requirements.in). The pip-compile manager updates the .in and regenerates the lock WITH hashes; pip_requirements must NOT touch the lock or it would bump a version without regenerating --hash lines, breaking the --require-hashes install. Keep it disabled for that file.
Docs toolchain (mkdocs-material + mike + transitive deps) bumps land in one PR via the pip-compile lock; chore(deps) keeps the conventional-title check happy.
